saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Βασιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian row already keeps, and the name is the same — «Άγιος Βασιανός» against doxologia's «Sfântul Cuvios Vasian». The Romanian source gave no life at all; this one gives Syria, the reign of Marcian about 450, the teaching at Constantinople, Matrona among his women disciples, a death in great old age and a church built in his name. The page states «περί το 450 μ.Χ.» for the reign, so a `dates` object is proposed from its own words as a floruit and not as a death. It prints no hymn for him. The identification rests on the shared civil day and the shared name and rank, and on nothing else, because the Romanian page said nothing that could be compared; it is flagged in the reader's report. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
